subject: POC: hands-on load orchestration & benchmark window
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@greenstack.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC: hands-on load orchestration & benchmark window

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, GreenStack is ready to move to a short POC that includes: a hands-on prompt review, routing/kv-cache checks, and a single-day load/benchmark window to validate throughput & latency SLOs.

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue Nov 9: 10:00–14:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed Nov 10: 08:00–12:00 PT
- Thu Nov 11: 13:00–17:00 PT

Target goals you mentioned on the call: 1k reqs/min peak, 95th pct latency <= 250ms for 2k tokens avg. Can you confirm those numbers (or correct them)? Also let us know if you need a pre-hook run to validate auth/network (VPN/SFTP) — we can provide a short-runbook.

I’m looping in infra and benchmarks from our side (Aditya for test harness; Marissa for run coordination). If any of the windows above are challenging, tell us which timezone works best and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: short runbook stub (runbook_v1.pdf) — this is a living doc, not the final one.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
--Attachment: runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 2 pages) --

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@greenstack.ai>

Date: 2027-11-01T14:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: POC: hands-on load orchestration & benchmark window

On Mon, Nov 1, 2027 at 9:12 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Olivia —
>
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday...

Thanks Irene — excited to move forward. Nov 9 works best for our team (we prefer morning ET).

Confirming targets:
- Peak throughput: 1,000 requests/minute (sustained 15-minute bursts)
- 95th pct latency target: <= 250ms for an average 2k-token response
- Error budget: 0.5% (all error classes)

Infra contact: Ashok Patel (ashok@greenstack.ai) — he’ll coordinate network/VPN and provide SFTP credentials if needed.

We’ll also share a sample prompt set and expected user mix by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Product, GreenStack AI
olivia@greenstack.ai
--Note: will attach prompts_sample.csv in next reply--

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC: hands-on load orchestration & benchmark window

Team — forwarding GreenStack confirmation. Nov 9 preferred slot; their infra lead Ashok will be looped. Quick asks before I lock in the calendar: 

1) Test harness: Aditya, can you confirm we can run the harness in the hosted env with a 1k RPM sustained burst and that we’ll collect per-route token counts, KV-cache hit rates, and per-request latency histograms (p50/p90/p95/p99)? Any special flags we should set?

2) Model variants: Rishi, recommend which model quantization profile to use for cost/latency parity—suggest a canary route for 8-bit quant and fallback to float as needed.

3) Logistics: Marissa, please provision a 4-hour booking (10:00–14:00 PT) with a 30-minute pre-check at 09:15 PT for network auth and a 30-minute wrap at the end for findings. Add p0 contact numbers. Please attach schedule (.ics) and the runbook excerpt we’ll use.

I’m sharing the latest runbook excerpt and the initial schedule in the attachments. If anyone anticipates resource conflicts, flag them now.

Thanks — Irene
--Attachment: runbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 2 pages)--

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC: hands-on load orchestration & benchmark window

Irene / all — quick update after checking capacity for Nov 9: we have a partial Dedicated pool scheduled for maintenance that morning. To avoid noisy neighbors, I recommend shifting to Nov 10 08:00–12:00 PT (same total run time).

Tech notes:
- Use quant-profile: q4_8bit for canary route; attach fallback route to the baseline fp16 model.
- Batching settings: max_batch_size=64, batch_timeout_ms=12 for request mix Olivia described.
- Please include a short warm-up period (10 minutes) at 50% load before the ramp to peak.

Marissa — I’ve created a calendar update and Drive runbook copy: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1poCexampleRunbook
I also attached a draft schedule (poc_schedule_update.ics) to the calendar invite.

If no objections I’ll update the HubSpot activity (HS-10234) and mark the date.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — Nov 10 08:00–12:00 PT (we’ll join early for warm-up) works for us.

We’ll upload the sample prompts (prompts_sample.csv) to the SFTP you provide and send the expected user-agent mix. Ashok will share credentials and will be present on the run day for network validation.

Small ask: can you add a short checklist to the runbook for verifying KV cache priming (we have a couple of long-tail prompts that need priming to avoid cold-start tail latency)?

Looking forward — Olivia
